audit_correction_verdicts.note: risk_coverage_auc([1.0, -inf], [0.0, 1.0]) returns a finite AUC and orders -inf last (worst). NaN score -> 'scores cannot contain NaN or positive infinity'. +inf score -> same rejection. Losses independently required finite and within [0,1].

audit_correction_verdicts.topic: Ephemeral download/checksum; delete raw before launch; never upload raw/sealed/recoverable text
audit_correction_verdicts.note: FAILS the row's 'launch never reads /raw' guarantee with concrete inputs. The model validator only checks the launch step's target/detail for the exact substring f'{workspace}/raw' (case-sensitive, single fixed path). Two hand-built plans were ACCEPTED while their launch step reads a surviving raw directory: (B5) extract to '/ws/RAW', delete '/ws/raw', launch detail 'read /ws/RAW/train.jsonl' -> accepted (case-variant defeats the check); (B6) extract to '/ws/sub/raw', delete '/ws/raw', launch detail 'read /ws/sub/raw/train.jsonl' -> accepted (nested raw dir is not '{workspace}/raw'). What HOLDS: the ordering invariant is sound (launch without delete_raw rejected; delete_raw after launch rejected; exact-case launch-reads-raw rejected; raw_retained=True rejected; non-allowlisted upload rejected via both factory and direct model), and the sanctioned factory plan_ephemeral_materialization derives raw_dir consistently and cannot produce an escaping plan. Because Plan 2 is pure contracts with no executor and the factory is safe, no raw data can actually leak this session -- hence REVISE, not STOP. FIX: before the raw check, normalize case/separators; check EVERY post-delete step (not only launch, not only the exact '{workspace}/raw') for any reference to a raw/extraction directory; and/or bind delete_raw.target to the actual extraction target(s) and reject launch if any raw-like extraction path is undeleted. Failing inputs recorded in challenge_attempts (B5, B6).

audit_correction_verdicts.topic: Sealed gold unrepresentable/unreachable; hash-linked label-access log; tamper-evident
audit_correction_verdicts.note: Sealed roles: unrepresentable at the manifest level (TrainingRoleManifest has no sealed field; extra field rejected by extra='forbid'); representable in a LabelAccessRequest (DataRole Literal includes them) but unreachable -- _authorize_label_access and build_label_access_log raise 'sealed gold role ... is unreachable', and LabelAccessLog.verify re-authorizes every entry so a forged sealed-role chain (A10) verifies False. Alternate spelling ('Certification') rejected by the closed Literal; extra 'secret_path' field rejected; development gold with SFT purpose rejected. Tamper detection: honest log verifies True; reordered entries -> False; single-field edit keeping old entry_hash -> False. OBSERVATION (not a row failure): a tail-truncated log with head_hash refit to the new last entry (A9) verifies True -- inherent to a self-describing hash chain with no external length/head commitment; verify() detects edits/reorders/substitutions/sealed-injection ('tamper of any entry') but cannot detect an omitted trailing read on its own. Recommend anchoring head_hash (and entry count) in the lineage manifest so completeness is externally checkable.

audit_correction_verdicts.topic: Naive unbatched infeasible; batched R0 forecast returns stop/infeasible if it cannot fit $24.7992
audit_correction_verdicts.note: Naive unbatched benchmark -> decision 'infeasible' (essential floor ~$3602 over cap). Over-scoped full plan with affordable essential path -> 'stop'. Core invariant holds unconditionally: over 20,000 randomized inputs, decision=='go' implied total_committed_usd <= remaining_budget_usd with ZERO violations. NOTE (input-trust, not a computation defect): safety_buffer and reserve_usd are caller-supplied and only validated >= 0, so passing safety_buffer=0.0 turned a properly-0.20-buffered 'infeasible' ($28.40) into 'go' ($24.00). The function is honest about the inputs it is given; recommend the frozen R0 forecast (and/or TrainingRunLedger authorization) pin safety_buffer >= 0.20 and reserve_usd > 0, or reject a forecast whose buffer is understated, so the recorded 'go' cannot be manufactured by zeroing conservatism.
